label: Sleep more
coaching_action: Fix a consistent lights-out time that protects 8.5 h in bed; screens off 45 min before; cool dark room; 20-min nap after short nights or early sessions.

label: Eat more protein
coaching_action: Spread 0.3-0.4 g/kg across 4-5 meals; add a protein-rich snack within 2 h of every session.

label: Fuel carbohydrates to load
coaching_action: Scale carbs to the day's load: +1 g/kg on moderate days, 6-8 g/kg the day before a match; carbs during sessions longer than 75 min.

label: Hydrate more
coaching_action: Pre-load 500 ml before sessions, weigh in/out to track sweat loss, and replace 150% of lost mass.

label: Re-balance training load
coaching_action: Keep week-on-week load change within ~10-15%; swap one high-intensity exposure for technical work when ACWR > 1.3, or add controlled volume when < 0.8.

label: Build aerobic capacity
coaching_action: Two weekly high-intensity interval sessions (e.g. 4 x 4 min at 90-95% max HR) on top of match and training load.

label: Improve sprint speed
coaching_action: One weekly max-velocity exposure (>=95% top speed) plus acceleration and technique drills, fully rested between reps.

label: Increase explosive power
coaching_action: Add jump and plyometric work twice weekly; pair with heavy lower-body strength.

label: Increase max strength
coaching_action: Two progressive strength sessions per week (squat/hinge patterns), 3-5 reps at 80-90% 1RM.

label: Strengthen hamstrings
coaching_action: Eccentric hamstring programme (Nordics) 2 x weekly, progressing volume over 8-10 weeks.
